cell.condition_text: If total lobbying expenditures/obligations made or incurred to any lobbyist for the principal exceed $200 during the reporting period, the principal must list the lobbyist’s name/address and the total amount paid/incurred.

instantiated_cells.justification: The expense statement requires itemization by lobbyist only when amounts to a given lobbyist exceed $200 in the reporting period.

unscoreable_emissions.reason: The bundled provisions define who is a 'lobbyist' (including a 5-days-per-reporting-period activity gate) but do not set any dollar compensation threshold for when an individual must be licensed/registered as a lobbyist.

The bundled text contains a principal registration threshold ($500/year) but no dollar expenditure threshold that triggers an individual lobbyist’s licensing/registration; lobbyists must be licensed unless exempt, regardless of expenditures.

The bundled text requires principals (not lobbyists) to file semiannual expense statements once registered, and contains some exclusions (e.g., employees devoting ≤10 hours), but does not specify a general dollar de minimis below which a lobbyist (as such) need not file.

The statute provides a time-based exclusion for certain non-lobbyist employees (≤10 hours per reporting period) and a 10% topic-time reporting rule for principals, but no time-percent de minimis threshold for lobbyist filing obligations.
